description:
## Context

`OctoPi.Agent.Message` (`apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/message.ex`, 24 lines) is a pure `@type` union module. It is aliased and type-annotated in several places but provides no runtime functions.

`Coder.Session` has a private `normalize/1` (around line 884-891) that accepts **any struct silently** — a type-safety hole (`defp normalize(%{__struct__: _} = m), do: m`).

`MessageLog` (`apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/message_log.ex`, line 21) stores `[term()]` instead of `[Message.t()]`.

Upstream `defaultConvertToLlm` in `tmp/pi-mono/packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts` L27-30 filters to only User/Assistant/ToolResult messages.

## Implementation steps

### 1. Add functions to Message module

`apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/message.ex` — add these three public functions:

```elixir
@spec normalize(String.t() | t() | [String.t() | t()]) :: t() | [t()]
def normalize(msgs) when is_list(msgs), do: Enum.map(msgs, &normalize/1)
def normalize(str) when is_binary(str),
  do: %User{content: str, timestamp: :os.system_time(:millisecond)}
def normalize(%User{} = m), do: m
def normalize(%Assistant{} = m), do: m
def normalize(%ToolResult{} = m), do: m
def normalize(invalid),
  do: raise(ArgumentError, "Expected Message.t() or String.t(), got: #{inspect(invalid)}")

@spec role(t()) :: :user | :assistant | :tool_result
def role(%User{}), do: :user
def role(%Assistant{}), do: :assistant
def role(%ToolResult{}), do: :tool_result

@spec convert_to_llm([t()]) :: [t()]
def convert_to_llm(messages), do: messages
```

### 2. Update MessageLog type

`apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/message_log.ex`, line 21:
```elixir
# Before:
@opaque t :: %__MODULE__{rev: [term()], count: non_neg_integer()}
# After:
@opaque t :: %__MODULE__{rev: [Message.t()], count: non_neg_integer()}
```
Add `alias OctoPi.Agent.Message` at top if not already present.

### 3. Replace private normalize in Session

`apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session.ex`: remove the private `normalize/1` definitions around lines 884-891 (the catch-all `%{__struct__: _}` clause is the bug). Search for all `normalize(` calls and replace with `Message.normalize(`.

### 4. Tests

Add tests (new file or extend `apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent_test.exs`):
- `Message.normalize/1` wraps bare string in `%User{}`
- `Message.normalize/1` accepts `%User{}`, `%Assistant{}`, `%ToolResult{}` unchanged
- `Message.normalize/1` raises `ArgumentError` on an unrecognized struct
- `Message.role/1` returns correct atom for each variant
- `Message.convert_to_llm/1` is identity for all three variants

## Notes
- Read `session.ex` before modifying — find all `normalize/1` call sites.
- The `%{__struct__: _}` catch-all is intentionally the bug being fixed — removing it is the point.
- Do NOT modify User, Assistant, or ToolResult structs.
title: Strengthen OctoPi.Agent.Message with public typed API; wire into MessageLog and Session
